name: AVA Infrastructure Fund
source: AVA Infrastructure Fund audited annual report for the year ended 31 December 2024 (NGX corporate disclosure). Statement of comprehensive income, printed page 21; statement of financial position, printed page 22; statement of cash flows, printed page 24. The fund was listed on the NGX main board on 10 May 2024 and raised 4.075 billion naira in its first series, so 2024 is its first reporting year and each statement prints a single column. | CRON 20260929_003746: Income Tax sign normalised to the dataset convention, the charge stored positive and a credit negative, on 1 period(s), so that the rendered Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit. The required sign is fixed by the direction of the move from Profit Before Tax to Net Profit in the stored rows, and the stored magnitude already agreed with that move. | CRON 20260929_183159: Operating Profit (EBIT) filled at the printed profit before tax 733,205 (N'000) for the single FY2024 column, from the statement of comprehensive income printed on page 21 of the same audited annual report (file _ngx_pdf/AVAIF.pdf). The fund reports no cost of sales, no finance cost and no earnings per share line: total income 799,087 less administrative expenses 65,883 gives the printed profit before tax 733,205, and withholding tax 79,969 gives the printed profit for the year 653,236. Gross Profit, Net Finance Costs and EPS are therefore left empty rather than filled by assumption.
unit: NGN, printed in thousands of naira and converted to naira. The filing's own rounding: the printed Total income line is 799,087 thousand naira while the two printed components, interest income 798,605 and other income 483, sum to 799,088, and net cash flow from operating, investing and financing activities sums to 4,312,239 against the printed net increase of 4,312,238. The printed lines are carried.
